title_tags.too_long: {count} pages have titles over 60 characters. Shorten them so search results do not cut them off.
title_tags.too_short: {count} pages have titles under 30 characters. Add the main keyword and a clear description.
title_tags.duplicate: {count} pages share duplicate titles. Rewrite each one to match its page.
title_tags.missing: {count} pages have no title tag. Add one to each.

meta_descriptions.missing: {count} pages have no meta description. Add a unique one to each, starting with top pages.

heading_tags.missing_h1: {count} pages have no H1. Add one that states the page topic.
heading_tags.multiple_h1: {count} pages have more than one H1. Keep one and change the rest to H2.
heading_tags.duplicate_h1: {count} pages share duplicate H1s. Make each one unique.

image_alts.missing_alt: {count} images have no ALT text. Add short, descriptive ALT text to each.
image_alts.oversized: {count} images are over 200 KB. Compress them or convert to WebP.

broken_links.404: {count} pages return 404. Redirect them to the closest live page or restore them.

url_redirects.302: {count} redirects use 302. Change them to 301 if the move is permanent.

schema.missing_types: The site lacks these schema types: {types}. Add them to the matching pages.

social_media.inactive: {platform} has had no activity for {days} days. Resume posting at least monthly.

google_business_profile.none: No Google Business Profile was provided. Create and verify one to appear in local results.

nap.missing: The site does not show a full business name, address, and phone number. Add them to the footer and contact page.
